crossRefs.note: “Go to the house of the Rechabites, and speak to them, and bring them into Yahweh’s house, into one of the rooms, and…
Go your way—eat your bread with joy, and drink your wine with a merry heart; for God has already accepted your works.
“But you gave the Nazirites wine to drink, and commanded the prophets, saying, ‘Don’t prophesy!’
For to this end I also wrote, that I might know the proof of you, whether you are obedient in all things.

people.name: Rechab
people.line: Ancestor of the Rechabites, who were faithful to God

translations.web: I set before the sons of the house of the Rechabites bowls full of wine, and cups; and I said to them, “Drink wine!”
translations.bsb: Then I set pitchers full of wine and some cups before the men of the house of the Rechabites, and I said to them, “Drink some wine.”
translations.kjv: And I set before the sons of the house of the Rechabites pots full of wine, and cups, and I said unto them, Drink ye wine.
translations.asv: And I set before the sons of the house of the Rechabites bowls full of wine, and cups; and I said unto them, Drink ye wine.
